title: Jing-Zhang V2 file-level rights status ledger
as_of_semantics: date of last real content edit, verified from git history during the Round 26 as_of consistency audit; it is not a validity or freshness guarantee
scope: All 141 files declared by this submission, including manifest.json, the complete source-rights and file-rights evidence chain, merged Round 7–18 contracts and figures, the Round 19 quality-only rebuild of the cover, ordinary-life triptych, bilingual key-area plans/sections, judgement-first visual/proposals, and fixed-size jury publications, plus the Round 20 bilingual review handoff package index; 140 entries are non-manifest content files. Final SHA-256 locking for currently changed files is intentionally deferred until concurrent independent review stabilizes their bytes.

evidence_contract.parent_asset_scope: parent_asset_refs records declared direct package inputs, not a universal build graph. Completeness is machine-enforced for metrics.json package-local source_files and the documented HTML, figure, and PDF generation inputs.

clearance_claim.statement: This ledger is a disclosure and release-gate record. It is not legal advice, an ownership certificate, a trademark clearance, or proof that every third-party term has been satisfied.

status_vocabulary.self_declared_origin_pending_independent: The submission identifies the material as created for this package, but no independent file-level rights audit is recorded.
status_vocabulary.repository_provisional_derivative: The file derives from repository-provided provisional material and inherits its non-official and rights-review limits.
status_vocabulary.generated_derivative_pending_embedded_as: The output was generated for the package, but embedded fonts, metadata, tool terms, and third-party elements have not been independently audited.
status_vocabulary.ai_generated_visual_with_deterministic_o: The image combines a generated synthetic base with a deterministic local overlay; model/output terms, rasterized fonts, metadata, and the exact file remain pending independent review.
status_vocabulary.package_authored_editable_source_pending: The submission identifies the SVG as an editable source authored for this package, but no independent file-level rights audit is recorded.
status_vocabulary.mixed_source_derivative_pending_independ: The file combines package-authored material with repository or third-party source traces and remains pending independent review.
status_vocabulary.pending_round19_final_bytes: Round 19 provenance structure is recorded, but the stored digest is deliberately retained as a prior snapshot until concurrent review stabilizes the exact file bytes; it is not a final identity claim.

file_coverage.coverage_rule: Every manifest path appears in exactly one compatibility asset_group and exactly one asset_record. Path coverage and resolvable declared parent links do not equal an exhaustive dependency graph or legal clearance.

asset_groups.name: Package records and machine-audit evidence
asset_groups.origin_basis: Authored or assembled for this submission from the declared repository task package and sources.json records.
limits: Repository source status is relied on but not independently re-licensed here.
Factual or regulatory authority remains governed by sources.json, not by authorship of these records.
Firecrawl retrieval caches are excluded from the submission; cited public webpages are recorded as citation-only evidence and are not reproduced as package assets.

The G0 offline enterprise-service baseline and three-file T-02 synthetic replay pack are project-authored structured/code artifacts and redistribute no external content. Their contract scope, Node.js runtime terms, responsible maintainer, retention, and release terms still require confirmation; they remain pending review within the overall not_fully_cleared status.

asset_groups.name: Bilingual narrative and rendered reports
asset_groups.origin_basis: Bilingual text and offline HTML prepared for this submission; cited facts remain attributable to sources.json.
limits: The COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY front-matter label is not a complete license grant because its full terms are not included in this package.
No independent plagiarism, quotation, model-output, or legal review is recorded.

asset_groups.name: Repository-derived provisional constraints
asset_groups.origin_basis: Derived from the repository provisional boundary package; not an official survey, redline, or approved key-area geometry.
limits: May support conceptual generation, display, and intake checks only.
Repository maintainers must confirm redistribution terms before use outside the repository workflow.

asset_groups.name: Conceptual design geometry
asset_groups.origin_basis: Conceptual design features authored for this submission using provisional constraints, repository enums, and OSM only as directional background.
limits: OSM-derived orientation, if retained in a redistributed database, requires ODbL-compliant attribution and share-alike review.
These files create no statutory control, engineering entitlement, or exclusive claim over public facts.

asset_groups.name: Generated visual and publication outputs
asset_groups.origin_basis: Figures, PDFs, and offline HTML generated for this package from bilingual narrative, structured evidence, and conceptual geometry. Sixteen package-authored bilingual SVG pairs—key areas, key-area sections, three-frame site reading, land-use duties, ordinary mobility, metrics/evidence, non-AI service, urban metabolism, failure governance, climate resilience, century timeline, industry/public value, year-round operations, professional handoff, field-evidence intake, and the public-signal interface—remain pending independent rights review; paired PNG files are deterministic display exports. The reversible-components pair remains separately grouped as a repository-provisional derivative.
limits: No standalone source font file is shipped. The four Round 19 PDFs contain visible NotoSansSC-Medium/Bold subsets and retain an unused, unembedded Helvetica resource. The accepted synthetic Round 19 cover contains rasterized DengXian glyph pixels. HTML requests system font stacks, and concrete fonts resolved while rasterizing the thirty-four checked-in SVG files were not recorded. Embedding, referencing, or rasterization does not establish license compliance.

Editable package-authored SVG sources are declared for sixteen bilingual figure pairs. The reversible-components pair is separately recorded as a repository-provisional derivative. Editable sources exist for Markdown, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON and GeoJSON, but no separate editable vector or publication-layout source is declared for every remaining PNG or PDF.
The conceptual JZ logo grammar has not received trademark or production-brand clearance.
